comment: Frame 169, printed p. 163: the editor's additions and corrections, «Nachträge und Verbesserungen.», in German, with the Arabic words and numerals that they concern; each is also recorded on the page that it concerns.
withheld: the editor's additions and corrections, «Nachträge und Verbesserungen.», in German: a heading and 19 printed lines, with the Arabic words and numerals that they concern (described in the observations below and recorded on the pages concerned)
observations: The page gives additions and corrections to the text and to the editor's footnotes, by page and line of the edition or by note. Its line numbers agree with the lines of the transcription (L01 the first line or row of a page); the printed page N is frame N + 6.

Corrections of the text, each a form to be read for the printed one, recorded as critical notes on the pages concerned: p. 17, line 13 (frame 023, L13), «برقة» for «ٮرقه» (AK05-CN017); p. 18, line 18 (frame 024, L18), «قبرس» for «قٮرس» (AK05-CN018); p. 20, line 8 (frame 026, L08), «المصّيصة», with a shadda over the ص, for «المصيصة» (AK05-CN019); p. 29, line 7 (frame 035, L07), «لح» for «لج», each with a line over the numerals: the degrees of the latitude of al-Andalus, 38 for 33 (AK05-CN020); p. 79, line 12 (frame 085, L12), «يٮ ن» for «بٮ ن», each followed by the note mark n: the latitude, 12° 50′ (AK05-CN021).
The mark i of the last note on p. 3 (frame 009), whose mark in the text stands after the minutes of the latitude of L12, has not printed in the footnotes; the page supplies it.

Corrections of the footnotes, recorded in the variants of the pages concerned: p. 30, note d (frame 036, L07), «ڡارنبسطين» for «ڡارنبسطس», the form of entry (2107), the loop without dots in both; p. 44, note f (frame 050, L17), «ٮٮطعں», ending in the bowl of a ن without its dot, for «ٮٮطعى», the form of entries (1762), (1764) and (1766); p. 121, note k (frame 127, L13), «ٮهريں» for «ٮهرين», the first reading of the manuscript, both with the first tooth without its dot, the first also with the final ن without its dot; p. 140, note l (frame 146, L09), «(٣٠٠)», the running number of Baghdad in the table of the cities (frame 027), for «[٣٠٠]», a number of Suhrāb.

Additions to the footnotes, recorded in the variants of the pages concerned: p. 7, note a (frame 013, L01): at entry (1503) the name «ڡلمادى», with the variant reading «ڡاڡادى»; p. 11, note a (frame 017, L01): at entry (1986) «اميرس»; p. 17, note a (frame 023, L05): at entry (1819) «اسفارٮوس»; p. 19, note e (frame 025, L16): perhaps «لسان» is to be read for «لبنان»; p. 25, note a (frame 031, L06): compare the town «طروب», with the variant reading «طرون», at entry (1943); p. 51, note c (frame 056, L02): at entry (1850) «سمس».

New notes to lines of the text, recorded as variants of the lines concerned: p. 12, line 7 (frame 018, L07), «ٮرباريا»: at entry (1822) «ٮرٮاريا», the second tooth without its dot; p. 12, line 8 (frame 018, L08), «طاووسن»: at entry (1815) «طاووس»; p. 17, line 4 (frame 023, L04): at entry (1745) «ماون»; p. 42, line 1 (frame 048, L01), «الجبل المحيط بجزيرة الياقوت»: at entry (1726) the mountain is called «جبل اروس احروسس» and «جبل الياقوت»; p. 50, line 3 (frame 056, L03), «جبل نهر سمس»: at entry (2049) «جبل نهر سقس»; p. 58, line 8 (frame 064, L08), «جبل كلمون»: at entries (1951) and (2116) «ٮلمون».

In the new note to p. 17, line 4, the word of the text is printed «اوں»: the alif, broken into three pieces, the و and the final ن without its dot of «ماوں» (frame 023, L04), without the initial م. The line ends at 2,070 px, where the other full lines of the page end at 2,093 to 2,100 px; the space left is the width of the م of «ماون» at the beginning of the line below. The م has not printed.

Marks not transcribed: two straight rules, 118 by 7 px, below «Anm.» and below «: bei» in the 17th line; a horizontal stroke, 37 by 4 px, at the foot of the s of «lies», running into the tip of the final ں of «ٮهريں», in the 18th line. Flaws of the impression.
Below the text, a short rule of 280 px, centred. At the foot, at the left, the signature «11*» of the printed sheet; the page number «— ١٦٣ —» stands at the foot, centred.
